# engineering-rules

> Guardrails for fast and AI-written code. One command adds a short rules file (AGENTS.md) and real gates to any repository: secret scan over full history, docs-check, policy gates, feature-flag expiry, PR size, and per-stack install, format, lint, types, test, build and audit for Node, Next.js, React, React Native, Vue, Angular, .NET, Laravel, Flutter, Python, Java, Go, Rust, Ruby, Swift, C/C++, Terraform and Docker. Plain bash and Node, runs locally, no paid CI needed. A gate that did not run is never a pass. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Gemini and human teams. English and Arabic editions.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): the problem, a real before/after demo, quick start
- [Skill entry point](skills/engineering-rules/SKILL.md): what an agent does and the hard rules
- [The binding rules](skills/engineering-rules/templates/AGENTS.md): the short rules file installed in a repository
- [Everything in one file](llms-full.txt): skill, rules, rule index, stack list and fix recipes
